name: What type of tile is safest for an accessible shower floor?

mainEntity.name: What type of tile is safest for an accessible shower floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners should look for slip resistance, cleanability, and smooth transitions when choosing shower tile for accessibility. Small-format tiles, such as 2x2-inch mosaics, provide ample grout lines that create natural friction and improve foot grip when wet. For roll-in showers, Abraham and his team ensure the transition between the bathroom floor and the shower floor is smooth, without sharp tile edges or sudden lips. Using durable, matte-finish porcelain or textured ceramic tile prevents slick surfaces while standing up to wheelchair traffic and daily moisture without deteriorating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small-format mosaic tiles or textured matte porcelain are safest because extra grout lines and textured finishes create dependable non-slip traction underfoot.
